dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: I don't know... You seem to me to have itchy feet. Places you have to go, things you have to do.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: How about you do what you've gotta do first. If I'm still around when you come back, then I'll be glad to take you on, so long as I've got strength in my bones.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: When that time comes, I will devote myself fully to passing on everything I know. All the tricks of the trade of the Fanmu Carpenter's will be yours.
